Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5152); Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham:--Nachor.
BiblicalUsage: Nachor is the Greek form of Nahor, and he stands in the genealogy of Jesus. In Luke 3:34 he appears as the son of Thara, the father of Abraham, in the line that runs from Adam to Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy is the proof that the promise travelled through real families. Nachor is one link in a chain that ends at Bethlehem, and the chain holds.
